# Proxima

> Proxima is a distributed ledger in which UTXO transactions are the vertices of a
> DAG called the tangle. There are no blocks, no mempool and no leader election.
> Consensus comes from the biggest ledger coverage rule — like Bitcoin's longest
> chain, but measured in token coverage of the ledger state rather than proof of
> work — and token holders converge on it by cooperating, which is also the most
> profitable thing each can do. Hence *cooperative consensus*.

This site is rendered with docsify, which builds every page in the browser. A
fetch of `https://lunfardo314.github.io/` or of any `#/`-style link returns a
~1.7 KB shell containing only the word "Loading…", because the part of a URL
after `#` is never sent to the server. **Fetch the `.md` files listed below
instead** — they are served directly as `text/markdown`. The rule is: drop the
`#`, add `.md`. So `/#/participate/mine` is fetched as `/participate/mine.md`.

The source code lives at https://github.com/lunfardo314/proxima — the ledger
rules in `ledger/`, the node in `core/`. Where this site and the code disagree,
the code is authoritative.

## Start here

- [Proxima manifesto](https://lunfardo314.github.io/manifesto.md): what the project is for and why it exists — beliefs, architectural principles, and the vision of a digital gold standard. The statement of intent behind every design decision.
- [What Proxima is](https://lunfardo314.github.io/overview/1-what-proxima-is.md): the plainest description of the ledger, for a reader who knows nothing Proxima-specific. Read this before anything else.
- [Landing page](https://lunfardo314.github.io/README.md): the site index. Mostly navigation.

## Overview of concepts

An ordered four-page spine, then reference pages behind it.

- [What Proxima is](https://lunfardo314.github.io/overview/1-what-proxima-is.md): page 1 of the spine — the ledger, the tangle, what makes it different from a blockchain.
- [Tokens and supply](https://lunfardo314.github.io/overview/2-tokens-and-supply.md): page 2 — PROX and motes, inflation's two components, and how supply grows.
- [Taking part](https://lunfardo314.github.io/overview/3-participate.md): page 3 — why there is no class of miners or validators, only token holders.
- [How transactions work](https://lunfardo314.github.io/overview/4-transactions.md): page 4 — the mechanics, explicitly not needed to hold, delegate or run a node.
- [Cooperative consensus](https://lunfardo314.github.io/overview/consensus.md): the deep treatment of the consensus rule, slots, and why the ledger converges. The longest page on the site.
- [UTXO ledger](https://lunfardo314.github.io/overview/utxo_ledger.md): the UTXO tangle as a data structure.
- [Safety and liveness](https://lunfardo314.github.io/overview/safety_liveness.md): Proxima framed as a Nakamoto consensus, and what it guarantees.
- [Being permissionless, and bootstrap](https://lunfardo314.github.io/overview/permissionless.md): what "permissionless" and "trustless" mean here, against the formal definitions.
- [Delegation and liveness](https://lunfardo314.github.io/overview/delegation.md): why consensus needs most of the supply participating every slot, and how delegation supplies it.

## Transaction model

- [Introduction](https://lunfardo314.github.io/txdocs/intro.md): the UTXO model Proxima builds on, and the few foundational concepts it adds.
- [Classical UTXO](https://lunfardo314.github.io/txdocs/utxo.md): what a UTXO is, for readers new to the term.
- [Base data elements](https://lunfardo314.github.io/txdocs/base.md): the byte-level types a transaction is defined and validated in.
- [Proxima transaction](https://lunfardo314.github.io/txdocs/tx.md): the transaction structure itself, tuple by tuple.
- [Validation](https://lunfardo314.github.io/txdocs/validation.md): how a raw transaction is validated before it updates the ledger state.
- [EasyFL](https://lunfardo314.github.io/txdocs/easyfl.md): the functional language UTXO constraints are written in — LISP-like, no recursion.
- [Native tokens and foundries](https://lunfardo314.github.io/txdocs/native_tokens.md): issuing tokens other than PROX.
- [Redeemer scripts](https://lunfardo314.github.io/txdocs/redeemer_scripts.md): keeping large scripts out of permanent state.

## UTXO programmability

- [Ledger definition library](https://lunfardo314.github.io/ledgerdocs/library.md): the single JSON file that defines the ledger and initializes it.
- [UTXO constraints and programmability](https://lunfardo314.github.io/ledgerdocs/constraints.md): how validity constraints on UTXOs make transactions programmable.
- [General purpose ledger definitions](https://lunfardo314.github.io/ledgerdocs/general-def.md): the library's general definitions and how constraint formulas are evaluated.

## Join Proxima

- [Join Proxima](https://lunfardo314.github.io/participate/participate.md): the entry point — who can take part and how.
- [Launch phase network](https://lunfardo314.github.io/participate/launch_network.md): what the launch phase network is and how to reach it.
- [Delegation](https://lunfardo314.github.io/participate/delegate.md): how to delegate tokens and earn from it without running anything.
- [Mining](https://lunfardo314.github.io/participate/mine.md): the fair launch — at genesis only 6% of the final supply exists; the rest is mined.
- [proxi CLI wallet](https://lunfardo314.github.io/participate/proxi.md): the command-line wallet and tool.
- [Running an access node](https://lunfardo314.github.io/participate/run_access.md): the simplest node configuration, with no sequencer.
- [Running a sequencer node](https://lunfardo314.github.io/participate/run_sequencer.md): the optional process that runs inside a node and actively takes part in consensus.
- [Running a standalone developer node](https://lunfardo314.github.io/participate/run_standalone.md): a local node for frontend and wallet developers.
- [Node configuration](https://lunfardo314.github.io/participate/node_config.md): every YAML tag read by the node, in `proxima.yaml`. The most detailed page on the site.
- [Wallet configuration](https://lunfardo314.github.io/participate/wallet_config.md): the `proxi.yaml` profile read by the CLI wallet.

## Blog

- [On definition of Nakamoto consensus](https://lunfardo314.github.io/blog/nakamoto.md): what makes a consensus Nakamoto, beyond proof of work. Background for the consensus pages.
- [On digital gold](https://lunfardo314.github.io/blog/digital_gold.md): revisiting the fundamentals of proof of work.
